vertexIdentity.anchorConvention: triangle index into triangleIndices; three barycentric weights refer to that exact immutable triangle; flat millimetres remain the original paper pattern

registration.assumption: Independent X/Y orthographic display scales fitted to assumed eyelet correspondences. This is an illustrative camera registration, not a metric calibration or recovered physical camera. Perspective and hidden lasting areas remain unresolved.

frame.toeConnectionPointMethod: Digitized user-painted toe-side endpoint, uncertainty approximately 3 photo pixels; not a factory datum

semanticRoles.topConnection: Connects body toe-side region and cuff upper-right; yellow tangent annotation is a graphical construction, not a measured curvature constraint.
semanticRoles.firstCuffSeamExtension: First original cuff seam extended toward the body boundary
semanticRoles.secondCuffSeamExtension: Second original cuff seam extended toward body boundary

strip.method: Minimum-area oriented rectangle fitted to both white PU halves, excluding blue button occlusion

physical.status: Photo observation only; 12 mm is a preset appearance diameter, not a global screenshot scale or PU width.

constraintCandidate.purpose: Optional test of the written parallel-axis / exact midpoint rules; not a replacement of user observed design

golden.kind: Recursive golden-rectangle quarter-circle construction; not an exact logarithmic spiral
golden.numberingIssue: Confirmed by the user: use the photographed blue button center, meaning the center of the complete circle supporting arc 5. It is not the endpoint of arc 4. Measured blue centers remain the placement authority despite the fitted-template residual.

centerDefinition.confirmation: 以图中蓝色扣心为准，即第五段完整圆的圆心
centerDefinition.note: The confirmation resolves the geometric meaning, not the remaining hand-drawing and template-fit errors. No observed blue center is moved to enforce ideal geometry.

golden.physicalScaleIssue: No global millimetres-per-pixel is inferred. The source cloth and hardware are not a calibrated fronto-parallel plane.

manufacturing.snapMaleFemaleCenters: Two contacts at an overlap may map to different original cloth points; each needs its own surface identity. A single visible pixel does not establish both.
manufacturing.cutLengthRule: bodyPiece = measured body-end-to-snap surface arc + overlap/2 + body sew allowance; cuffPiece = cuff arc + overlap/2 + cuff sew allowance. Symmetric overlap is a named assumption, not supplied manufacturing fact.

warnings: All extracted values are screenshot pixels with anti-aliasing/hand-drawing uncertainty, not factory dimensions.
Source drawn PU axes are not exactly parallel and blue button centers are not exactly the fitted full-strip midpoints. Default preserves the observed artwork.
Green construction lines are not a strict orthogonal rectangle; simultaneous three-edge coincidence has finite residual.
Only the final assembled 3D surface/triangle identity can supply reversible pattern-mm mapping; photo coordinates alone are not a paper pattern.
